Indeed we cannot love Jesus as we ought to do - cannot be devoted to His Sacred Heart without devotion to Mary. As St. Charles Boromeo says, Mary was be- queathed to us for our mother by the Sacred Heart in agony on the cross and we cannot love her but by His grace. And in similar manner we may say Jesus was given to us through Mary and only through Mary can we go to Jesus. . Only through her and with her can we arrive at true devotion to the Sacred Heart of her divine Son - where the love of God is everything to the soul and --- the soul is everything to God. regions.cleaned_text: ValeCh "Material Lord of the visible creation." For it en- livens and beautifies everything it touches. It calls forth the little flowers and clothes the forest and field and river and mountain, clouds and rainbow. It reflects itself on all nature and in a manner makes everything to speak of the Creator, so that the Psalmist exclaims as in ecstasy "O, all ye works of the Lord bless the Lord. Praise and exalt Him above all forever!" and as if conscious of this praise a mountain traveler of our own day exclaims
